== Summary ==
Before/after image for [[Finn, Resistance Hero]]: the PC card image of [[Finn, Resistance Hero]] (7 August 2025, [[:File:V25-L-finnresistancehero.gif|V25-L-finnresistancehero.gif]], scaled to the slip height) beside the slip of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (page 7). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026).
